Who can use Thousand Miles

You need an account. You must be at least 13, or the minimum age required in your region, and you're responsible for what happens under your account.

Acceptable use

  • Use Thousand Miles for personal health tracking and reflection.
  • Don't reverse-engineer, decompile, or attempt to extract source code.
  • Don't use Thousand Miles in any way that would violate applicable laws.
  • Don't attempt to circumvent usage limits on AI features, or use them to process anything other than your own meals.

Not medical advice

Thousand Miles surfaces patterns from what you log and what Apple Health shares. Readiness scores, recaps, nutrition estimates, and recommendations are informational only. They are not medical advice and don't replace a qualified clinician for any health decision. Nutrition estimates in particular are AI-generated approximations — check them before relying on them, and don't use them to manage a medical condition.

Your content

Your entries, photos, and notes remain yours. You grant us only the permission needed to store, back up, and display them back to you across your devices. We don't use your content to train AI models.

Availability

We may change or discontinue features. AI estimation depends on a third-party service and is subject to daily limits; it may be unavailable at times.

Thousand Miles Plus

Thousand Miles is free to use. Thousand Miles Plus is an optional auto-renewing subscription that adds:

  • AI nutrition estimates, up to ten a day. This is a fair-use limit, and it resets each day.
  • Photo backup of up to 2 GB, about 4,000 photos. Without Plus, your first 200 photos are backed up. After that, new photos stay on your device only.

Plans and prices:

  • Thousand Miles Plus Monthly: US$5.99 a month.
  • Thousand Miles Plus Yearly: US$49.99 a year.

Prices in other countries and currencies are set by the App Store and may include local taxes. The price shown on the purchase screen before you confirm is the one you pay.

Free trial: a new subscriber may be offered a 7-day free trial. When the trial ends, the subscription starts and you are charged for the plan you chose, unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the trial ends. Each Apple Account can use one trial. If you buy a subscription during a free trial, any unused part of the trial is forfeited.

Payment and renewal:

  • Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase.
  • Your subscription renews automatically at the same price and for the same length, unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
  • Your account is charged for the renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends.
  • If the price changes, Apple will tell you in advance and, where required, ask you to agree before you are charged the new price.

Managing and cancelling: manage or cancel your subscription in your device's Settings → [your name] → Subscriptions, or from Profile → Thousand Miles Plus in the app. Cancelling stops the next renewal. Plus stays active until the end of the period you have already paid for. You will not get a refund for the rest of that period, except where the law requires one.

Refunds: purchases are processed by Apple, and Apple handles all refunds. To request one, go to reportaproblem.apple.com. We cannot issue refunds ourselves.

When Plus ends, AI estimates stop and photo backup goes back to the free limit. Nothing you have already logged or backed up is deleted. Your entries, estimates and photos stay yours, on your devices and on our servers.

Changes to Plus: we may change what Plus includes or its daily limits. If a change takes something away from Plus, we will tell you in the app before it takes effect. Any change to the price goes through Apple as described above.
